decisions.rule: Treat Binance's approximately $5B corresponding-token assets already held as aggregate company-reported USD value, not token-by-token XRP replenishment or proof of customer liabilities.
decisions.rationale: No XRP-specific amount or same-time per-token liability reconciliation was disclosed.

decisions.rule: Set special 12-hour PoR target to 2026-10-31T07:33Z and 34-hour phased withdrawal target to 2026-11-01T05:33Z, calculated from the official 2026-10-30T19:33Z announcement.
decisions.rationale: Previous 34-hour target of 2026-10-31T05:33Z was a 24-hour arithmetic error; preserve historical entry and supersede with correction.

decisions.rule: Keep CoinDesk's Binance 14 PoR membership evidence limited to Ethereum; do not extrapolate to XRPL XRP source wallets.
decisions.rationale: CoinDesk identifies Binance 14 and ETH/USDT; five XRPL wallet membership remains unresolved.

decisions.rule: Represent Coinbase as a multi-stablecoin Everything Exchange: it renewed the Circle arrangement on the same terms while announcing RLUSD distribution with Ripple.
decisions.rationale: Coinbase Q3 filing and Ripple/Coinbase October 28 announcement support coexistence, not simple Circle replacement.

decisions.rule: Mark Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral support as future follow-on until a live listing or actual collateral ledger proves activation.
decisions.rationale: Ripple's official announcement says collateral support 'will follow'.

decisions.rule: Model Circle Arc and XRPL as potentially competing and complementary rails; Arc uses USDC for gas while Circle also issues native USDC on XRPL and has a direct Ripple partnership.
decisions.rationale: Circle Arc announcement, Circle USDC-on-XRPL release and Ripple/Circle partnership.

decisions.rule: Do not convert USDC/RLUSD transaction count into XRP demand. Record native XRP fee burn separately at observed fee levels.
decisions.rationale: XRPL minimum standard fee is 10 drops; one million minimum-fee transactions destroy 10 XRP.

decisions.rule: Keep PR #1401 draft/unmerged pending review of artifact-only Pages tradeoff and remaining scheduled/manual writers.
decisions.rationale: Direct main-writer root cause confirmed; PR removes automatic web JSON/Pages refresh and addresses Cross Analysis only.

decisions.rule: Do not issue directional XRP forecast until synchronized provider data, fixed-horizon outcomes, walk-forward baselines and calibration are executed.
decisions.rationale: Current derivatives/reserve datasets remain non-comparable and PR #1400 is only a proposed ledger.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Binance's reported $5B corresponding-token assets may cover a large share in aggregate but do not establish XRP-specific reserve restoration.
disconfirming_or_alternative: A later token-by-token PoR could show XRP fully covered.
The $5B may include exact XRP quantities not enumerated in the announcement.

competing_hypotheses.statement: CoinDesk's Binance 14 PoR finding is ETH/USDT-specific and must not be extrapolated to the five XRPL source wallets.
disconfirming_or_alternative: An official address export could show one or more XRP source wallets in the PoR set.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Coinbase is expanding as a multi-stablecoin Everything Exchange rather than replacing Circle with Ripple.
disconfirming_or_alternative: Future distribution economics or product delistings could materially shift the balance.
RLUSD may gain share at USDC's expense, but Q3 data predates RLUSD launch.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Coinbase RLUSD distribution may increase RLUSD/XRPL activity but does not automatically create material XRP spot demand.
disconfirming_or_alternative: Measured bridge-currency or collateral demand could create additional XRP acquisition if order-book and flow data confirm it.
Current minimum fee burn is small and no net XRP acquisition data is available.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Circle Arc is a competing stablecoin-native institutional rail while Circle's USDC-on-XRPL and Ripple partnership create complementary relationships.
disconfirming_or_alternative: Arc/StableFX may substitute for some XRPL settlement.
USDC and RLUSD use may expand across both networks rather than displace either.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Coinbase's Circle distribution economics remain material despite the new RLUSD partnership.
disconfirming_or_alternative: Future filings may show a material change in the arrangement or revenue share.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The Cross Analysis workflow directly caused the repeated unsigned timestamp-only main commits.
disconfirming_or_alternative: Other workflows may also write main, but this specific commit is directly traced to Cross Analysis.

next_actions: Locate Binance special post-incident PoR and verify actual snapshot timestamp, then compare XRP liabilities and reserve addresses.
Obtain official Binance October 1 and post-incident address exports; crosswalk all five XRPL source wallets and keep Binance 14 separate.
Refresh raw XRPL account_info and transaction history for the attacker receiver and five source wallets.
Reconcile token-specific Binance replacement quantities; do not infer XRP demand from the $1.34B aggregate estimate.
Measure RLUSD supply, Coinbase deposits/withdrawals and XRPL balances by chain; separate mint/redemption from exchange transfers.
Measure Circle USDC on XRPL, RLUSD on XRPL, Arc USDC activity and StableFX flows to test competition versus complementarity.
Reconcile Coinbase Q3 Circle economics with October 28 RLUSD launch; Q3 financials predate the launch.
Review PR #1401 Pages-refresh tradeoff and remaining main writers before approval.
Extend PR #1400 only after point-in-time feature store and fixed-horizon outcomes are executable; no forecast until calibration and walk-forward tests pass.
